description: Two-column FAQ section with a heading, supporting copy, and a support-link paragraph on the left, and a collapsible single-open accordion of questions on the right. Each answer text animates in with a per-letter staggered blur-to-focus reveal using framer-motion when its accordion item opens. Includes a mobile-only contact link below the accordion for small screens.
example_prompts: FAQ section with an accordion and a nice text reveal animation for the answers
Two column FAQ layout with heading on the left and expandable questions on the right
Animated FAQ accordion where the answer fades and blurs into view
